identity.visualCharacter: Minimalist flat motion-graphics explainer with bold uppercase kinetic typography over dark, moody backgrounds; calm, typographic, editorial feel with a social-quote branding aesthetic
identity.backgroundTreatment: Solid very dark desaturated teal/near-black fields with a soft radial vignette darkening the edges; occasional shift to a dark warm brown variant for contrast; faint texture, otherwise clean and uncluttered
identity.negativeSpace: Extremely generous — typically one text block plus a single flat icon per frame, leaving roughly 60-70% of the frame empty; transition frames (image 6) are almost entirely empty negative space with only a fading word
identity.objectStyle: Flat vector minimalism: outline clocks with thin tick marks and simple hands, rounded-corner human avatar pictograms, dashed placeholder squares, and a rounded speech-bubble logo; uniform thin-to-medium strokes, no gradients or shadows, muted teal fills with white/yellow accents
identity.lighting: Flat, even, non-directional digital lighting with no cast shadows; vignette acts as the only luminance variation, pulling focus toward the bright center
identity.contrast: High typographic contrast — bright white or saturated accent text against near-black backgrounds; accents limited to a small palette (magenta/pink, golden yellow, teal) so color itself creates emphasis
identity.visualHierarchy: Hierarchy is driven by type size, weight, and accent color: large bold uppercase headline first (white line + colored emphasis line), smaller lighter subtitle beneath, and a small caption/label under the single supporting icon; eye path is left-aligned text block → right-side or lower icon → label

motion.entrance: Elements enter via progressive staged reveal: headline lines appear one after another (first line, then accent-colored second line), and small UI card icons pop in sequentially along a horizontal row; entrances are subtle fades/small positional settles rather than large off-screen travel.
motion.exit: Exits are not clearly observable within the sampled frames; scene changes appear to replace content wholesale (cut/dissolve to a new layout) rather than showing individual elements animating out.
motion.objectMovement: The simplified human figure and card row are largely static once placed; the figure only changes position between scene layouts (center in one scene, right side in another), indicating layout repositioning across cuts rather than continuous on-screen motion.
motion.textMovement: Text appears to reveal progressively left-to-right/top-to-bottom, with later words/lines trailing in as if typed or word-by-word; final resting positions are fixed, with no visible drift after the reveal completes.
motion.scaleBehavior: Scale changes are minimal — elements seem to settle at full size with, at most, a slight fade-up or micro scale-in on cards; the overall measured diff (0.0112) implies no dramatic scaling.
motion.easing: Smooth, restrained easing with soft settles; no visible bounce or overshoot in the sampled frames, leaning toward ease-out rather than snappy or springy motion.
motion.transitionBehavior: Between sequences the background color, layout, and composition change completely (teal → warm brown → teal → brown), suggesting hard cuts or quick cross-dissolves paired with fresh staged text entrances rather than continuous element carryover.
motion.camera: Static camera with fixed framing; no panning, zooming, or parallax detectable — motion comes from content reveals within a locked frame.
motion.emphasis: Emphasis is achieved typographically and through color: accent lines switch to teal/pink-red, staggered line-by-line reveals draw attention to key phrases rather than through motion accents.
